newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS RUSSIAN LEASING ARM TO START WORK.
newsitem.headline: UHIS RUSSIAN LEASING ARM TO START WORK.

text.p: Uhispank said on Thursday it hopes to start its Russian leasing subsidiary in St Petersburg in the following week.
"The company is registered and we hope to get a licence in the following days," the bank's vice president, Janek Maggi, told Reuters.
Uhispank in April signed an agreement to establish Venemaa Uhisliising (Russian Uhis Leasing) with Russian company Neva-Rus. Uhispank has 75 percent of the company's shares.
Maggi said the leasing subsidiary has already many potential clients.
"The clients with whom we will start are reliable. Many are government bodies and companies linked to the West in order to reduce the high risks," Maggi said.
